bhubaneswar.orientation: Begin with the city’s heritage, then follow the collection to Dhauli and the coast.
story: Odisha Tourism describes Bhubaneswar through Hindu, Buddhist and Jain heritage, and a modern capital planned by Otto Königsberger. These layers invite different kinds of looking: a temple detail, a street plan, a landscape of remembrance.
Our suggestion: give the city and Dhauli their own attention. Do not turn the whole collection into a single hurried circuit.

coastal_food.sweet_finish: The Puri guide also points visitors towards chhena poda: a browned edge and a softer centre. Ask when it was made and which ingredients were used. It is a dairy sweet; recipes and additions can vary.
